title: Pile of ticket stubs. I need to get this history captured online #IndieWeb
summary: Do memories fade Like ink? Lost to the trap of time Sunspots and memory holes. Soon I could lose these Gone and never coming back How to document some 400 shows over 30 years?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Do memories fade

Like ink? 

Lost to the trap of time

Sunspots and memory holes. 

Soon I could lose these

Gone and never coming back

How to document some 400 shows over 30 years?
